subject: Syntax for correlating residual variances of factors

messages.author: 54449e95e727bc4e
messages.subject: Syntax for correlating residual variances of factors
parts:
Hello,

I would like to run a model which looks like the attached PDF.

The code I have so far is: 

1            model <- 'F1 =~ I1 + I2 + I3

2            F2 =~ I4 + I5 + I6 + I7 + I8 + I9

3            F3 =~ I10 + I11 + I12 + I13        

4            residual variance of F1 ~~ residual variance of F2

5            residual variance of F1 ~~ residual variance of F3

6            residual variance of F2 ~~ residual variance of F3

7            I1 ~ C

8            I2 ~ C

9            I3 ~ C

10           F2 ~ C

11           F3 ~ C’


I am wondering what code to put in lines 4-6 to correlate the residual variances of my F1, F2 and F3 factors? Would it just be F1~~F2 or would it be more like F1~~F1 ~~ F2~~F2?

Thanks,

Sarah
